task: Classify immune class in clear cell renal cell carcinoma of the kidney. Classes: low, medium, and high immune infiltration. Key H&E cues include the density and distribution of lymphocytes and other inflammatory cells within tumor nests and stroma, along with associated stromal reaction and necrosis.

classes.0: Low immune class with sparse tumor-infiltrating inflammatory cells and relatively immune-desert tumor and stromal areas.
classes.1: Medium immune class with a moderate, patchy inflammatory infiltrate in tumor and stroma.
classes.2: High immune class with dense and widespread tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes or other inflammatory cells, often with brisk stromal inflammation.
